name: aem-a2ui-demo
description: AI-powered content assistant for Adobe Experience Manager

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.dev:ai: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server:ai"
scripts.dev:server:ai: cd agent-java && AI_ENABLED=true LLM_PROVIDER=ollama mvn spring-boot:run
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
scripts.setup: npm install && cd client && npm install
